## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `grp` | `string` | **yes** | The product group's id (a slug id, e.g. `default`). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | The product group's name. |
| `code` | `string` | no | The product group's code, unique within the business. |
| `description` | `string` | no | The product group's description. |
| `active` | `boolean` | no | false to archive, true to restore |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The product group's id (`default`). |
| `code` | `string` | The product group's code, unique within the business. |
| `name` | `string` | The product group's name. |
| `description` | `string` | The product group's description. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the product group is active. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Code in use / has active products |
| `404` | No such product group |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |
